name: AddWeb Woo Multi-address
author: AddWeb Solution

sections.description:
AddWeb Woo Multi-address empowers WooCommerce stores by letting customers manage multiple billing and shipping addresses from their account and easily select them during checkout.

Whether your store uses the classic checkout, Elementor-based templates, or WooCommerce blocks, this plugin ensures a seamless experience.

Features

✅ Manage Multiple Addresses from My Account
Customers can add, edit, or delete multiple billing and shipping addresses from their “My Account” area, and set default ones for faster checkout.

✅ Address Dropdown at Checkout
Custom dropdown fields on the checkout page let users select from their saved addresses. The selected address auto-fills the billing or shipping fields accordingly.

✅ Address Display in Order Details
Selected addresses appear clearly in the order summary — improving clarity for customers and store admins.

✅ Supports All WooCommerce Checkout Methods
– Classic WooCommerce checkout
– Elementor-powered checkout pages
– WooCommerce block checkout (Cart & Checkout blocks)
– Block-based WordPress themes

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly from the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Customers will now see a new multi-address management area under My Account → Addresses.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with custom checkout pages?

Yes! It supports Elementor-based and block-based checkout pages in addition to the default WooCommerce checkout.

Will it affect performance or the checkout process?

No. It only enhances the address selection process and falls back to default WooCommerce behavior when not in use.

Can I customize the address fields or behavior?

Yes. The plugin is built with hooks and filters so developers can extend or modify functionality as needed.
